text: Based on the evidence, **no**—the property did not lose 67.7 ha of tree cover *after* the EUDR cut-off date (December 31, 2020). The 67.7 ha loss occurred **in 2020 itself**, which is outside the claim interval (2021–2025). Post-2020, only minor losses (0.4 ha in 2021) were detected, all below the 0.5 ha event threshold. The assessment confirms **no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more** occurred within the asset after the baseline.
